note: Los Padres NF campground at about 7,300 ft on Mt. Pinos, in open Jeffrey and ponderosa pine on paved loops; managed by Camp Los Padres. Sites are short back-ins, only about a third long enough for a 23-ft rig, and posted lengths are enforced; some entrances angle against traffic, so pull in nose first. --Claude
